title: Seismic Fractal Analysis: Multi-Planar Hierarchy Framework
description: Python package for fractal dimension analysis of earthquake catalogs. Implements Grassberger-Procaccia correlation dimension, Bayesian dimension recovery, Rényi multifractal spectrum, topological graph structure analysis via Leiden communities, and bootstrap uncertainty quantification. Analyzes 50,010 earthquakes across Pan-American margin (2010-2025), revealing multi-planar hierarchical organization underlying apparent planar seismicity.
